name: sheets-hover-highlighter
description: Google スプレッドシートで、マウスポインタの下にあるセルの行と列を強調表示する Chrome 拡張機能

scripts.build-chrome: node tools/make_manifest.ts chrome development && node tools/build.ts chrome development
scripts.watch-chrome: node tools/make_manifest.ts chrome development && node tools/build.ts chrome development watch
scripts.release-chrome: node tools/make_manifest.ts chrome production && node tools/build.ts chrome production
scripts.package-chrome: npm run release-chrome && node tools/archive.ts chrome
